note: Commerce Square provides a Drupal Commerce on-site payment gateway plugin `square` (Amex/Visa/MC/Discover/JCB/UnionPay/DinersClub; modes test=Sandbox, live=Production; supports authorizations & refunds). App-level credentials live in config object commerce_square.settings (app_name, app_secret, sandbox_app_id, sandbox_access_token, production_app_id); production access/refresh tokens live in Drupal STATE (commerce_square.production_access_token etc). Per-gateway settings on the commerce_payment_gateway entity: test_location_id, live_location_id, enable_credit_card_icons, mode. Service commerce_square.connect (class Connect) builds a Square\SquareClient. Requires square/square. Live charges call Square's API over the network, so ALL medium/hard cases are grounded in LOCAL config/state (the gateway entity and commerce_square.settings), never in real API calls.

evals.prompt: What kind of Drupal Commerce payment gateway does commerce_square provide (plugin id and type), and what modes does it support?
evals.expected_output: It provides an on-site credit-card payment gateway plugin id `square` (class Square extends OnsitePaymentGatewayBase, supports authorizations and refunds) with two modes: `test` (Sandbox) and `live` (Production).

evals.prompt: Where does commerce_square store its application-level credentials, and what are the key names for the sandbox application id and sandbox access token?
evals.expected_output: In the config object commerce_square.settings, keys sandbox_app_id and sandbox_access_token (plus app_name, app_secret, production_app_id). Production access/refresh tokens are kept in Drupal state, not config.

evals.prompt: Which external PHP library does commerce_square require, and which Drupal service builds a configured Square API client?
evals.expected_output: It requires the square/square PHP SDK. The service commerce_square.connect (class Connect) builds a configured Square\SquareClient via getClient($mode).

evals.prompt: This site has a Square payment gateway configured. Inspect the live payment gateway configuration and report the Test (Sandbox) Location ID set on the Square gateway.
evals.expected_output: The Square gateway (csq_known) has test_location_id = L_TEST_KNOWN in commerce_payment.commerce_payment_gateway.csq_known configuration.

evals.prompt: Inspect the live commerce_square application settings on this site and report the configured Sandbox Application ID.
evals.expected_output: The Sandbox Application ID is sandbox-sq0idb-KNOWN123 (commerce_square.settings:sandbox_app_id).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a Drupal Commerce payment gateway with the id csq_build that uses the Square payment gateway plugin, in test (Sandbox) mode. Apply it to the live site. (Do not attempt any live Square API call.)
evals.expected_output: Create a commerce_payment_gateway config entity: PaymentGateway::create(['id'=>'csq_build','label'=>...,'plugin'=>'square','status'=>true,'configuration'=>['mode'=>'test',...]])->save(). Stored as commerce_payment.commerce_payment_gateway.csq_build with plugin square and mode test.

evals.prompt: Set the commerce_square sandbox credentials on this site: put the Sandbox Application ID to sq0idp-BUILD and the Sandbox Access Token to EAAA-BUILD. Apply to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: In commerce_square.settings set sandbox_app_id='sq0idp-BUILD' and sandbox_access_token='EAAA-BUILD' (e.g. drush cset commerce_square.settings sandbox_app_id sq0idp-BUILD; drush cset commerce_square.settings sandbox_access_token EAAA-BUILD).
